textures.name: Grass
textures.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single seamless tileable square albedo texture for the ground of a low-poly hex-grid fantasy strategy game. Primary request: muted olive meadow grass, base palette #759754. A patchwork of soft short grass blades arranged in natural small clusters, subtle variations of dry straw and tiny exposed brown soil. No flowers, no shrubs, no long strands. Viewed perfectly straight down, orthographic, no perspective. Subtle hand-painted stylized natural forms, soft-edged low-contrast medium-scale detail, matte, quiet readable palette, compatible with simple low-poly natural scenery. Treat the full square as a continuous surface, with equivalent feature density at all edges and center; seamless repeat in both axes. Neutral diffuse color only: no directional lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion shadows, specular highlights or vignette. No 3D diorama, no border, no hexagon, no islands, no scenery, no text, no labels, no watermark. Deliver only the full-bleed texture map.
